rows.heading: Update.
rows.current_text: No later than the third year after the effective date of this section and every third year thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the city council proposed amendments that he or she determines should be made to this code to bring it up to date with the latest edition of the International Plumbing Code or otherwise modify the provisions thereof. In addition, prior to the submission of such proposal to the city council, such proposal shall be submitted to an advisory committee established by the commissioner pursuant to this title for review and comment.

Article 601: Enactment and Update of the New York City Plumbing Code

rows.heading: Enactment of the New York City Plumbing Code.
rows.current_text: The New York city plumbing code based on the 2003 edition of the International Plumbing Code published by the International Code Council, with changes that reflect the unique character of the city and amendments that bring it up to date with the 2015 edition of such International Plumbing Code, is hereby adopted to read as follows:
